d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and two long strands framing the face. Sharp, narrow amber eyes with a focused, mature expression on a youthful face. A slender build, wearing a white and silver high-collared dress with a short pleated skirt, flowing translucent white fabric panels, and matching white thigh-high stockings. Accessories include white pointed ear-guards, a small red ribbon tied in the hair, and a large, ornate gold circular halo and bow-like structure floating behind.
